en.title: KJ Apa, Isabel May's 'Falling' Lands North American Release This October
en.summary: Get ready for a dose of London-set romance! KJ Apa and Isabel May are set to star in the upcoming YA drama 'Falling,' which has secured a theatrical release in North America.
en.body:
The romantic drama **‘Falling’**, featuring **KJ Apa** ('Riverdale'), **Isabel May** ('Scream 7'), and **Archie Renaux** ('Alien: Romulus'), is officially heading to cinemas across North America. Brainstorm Media has acquired the distribution rights for the film, which hails from writer/director brothers James and Colin Krisel and is produced by Gulfstream Pictures.

The film, described as a romantic dramedy, was announced at the American Film Market in 2025 and is slated for a theatrical launch on October 9th, with further release details to follow. The ensemble cast also includes **Emma Laird**. This move by Brainstorm Media suggests a strategic play to capture the dedicated audience that flocks to these types of stories, especially with a cast that already boasts significant fan followings from popular series and films.

## A New Romance on the Horizon

The premise of **‘Falling’** promises a compelling narrative set against the backdrop of London, exploring themes of love and connection. While specific plot details remain under wraps, the combination of its talented young cast and the romantic dramedy genre positions it as a potentially significant release for fans of heartfelt storytelling. The involvement of the Krisel brothers as writer-directors offers a unique creative vision, and their previous work, though less widely known than their stars, will be a point of interest for cinephiles.

The acquisition by Brainstorm Media is a crucial step, ensuring that **‘Falling’** will reach a wide audience through theatrical distribution. This approach often allows films to build buzz and critical reception before potentially moving to streaming or other platforms, giving audiences the chance to experience the story on the big screen.

## What Fans Can Expect

For fans of **KJ Apa** and **Isabel May**, this film represents an exciting new chapter in their careers, showcasing their versatility beyond their most well-known roles. Apa’s turn as Archie Andrews in 'Riverdale' and May’s recent work in 'Scream 7' have cemented their status as rising stars, and **‘Falling’** offers them a chance to lead a romantic narrative. The anticipation is palpable among their respective fan bases, eager to see how they interact and bring their characters' story to life. The film's announcement at AFM last year generated considerable interest, and the upcoming theatrical release is the culmination of that early excitement.

## What's Next

With the North American theatrical release set for October 9th, audiences can look forward to experiencing **‘Falling’** in cinemas very soon. Further details regarding international distribution and potential streaming availability are expected to be announced in the coming months, so keep an eye out for updates.
